1.word_for_word: द्वात्रिंशे विरहालाप-विक्लिन्न-हृदयो हरिः । — In the thirty-second century, the Lord’s heart was torn by the conversation of separation.; तत्राविर्भूय गोपीस् ताः सान्त्वयामास मानयन् ॥इ॥ — There he appeared and consoled the gopis honoring them; स्व-प्रेमामृत-कल्लोल-विह्वली-कृत-चेतसः । — They were overwhelmed by the nectar of their own love.; सद् अयं नन्दयन् गोपीर् उद्गतो नन्द-नन्दनः ॥इइ॥ — This good one, the delight of Nanda, has emerged, delighting the gopis.; इति गोप्य इति । — It is called Gopya.; इत्य् एवं प्रभृति । — It is and so on.; चित्रधा अनेकधा सुस्वरम् उच्चैः कृष्णदर्शने लालसातिस्पृहा यासां ताः ॥१॥ — Those whose voices are loud in many ways and in many ways are very longing for the sight of Krishna.
1.translation: In the thirty-second century, the Lord’s heart was torn by the conversation of separation. There he appeared and consoled the gopis honoring them They were overwhelmed by the nectar of their own love. This good one, the delight of Nanda, has emerged, delighting the gopis. It is called Gopya. It is and so on. Those whose voices are loud in many ways and in many ways are very longing for the sight of Krishna.

2.word_for_word: साक्षान् मन्मथ-मन्मथो जगन्-मोहनस्य कामस्यापि मनस्य् उद्भूतः कामः साक्षात् तस्यापि मोहक इत्य् अर्थः ॥२॥ — This means that lust arises in the mind of the deluder of the universe and is directly deluding him.
2.translation: This means that lust arises in the mind of the deluder of the universe and is directly deluding him.

3-4.word_for_word: तन्वः कर-चरणादयः ॥३-४॥ — The body, hands, feet, etc. 3-4

5.word_for_word: अञ्जलिना संहत-हस्त-द्वयेन ॥५॥ — With both hands folded in palms.
5.translation: With both hands folded in palms.

6.word_for_word: भ्रुकुटिं भ्रुवम् आबद्ध्य कुटिलीकृत्य प्रेम-संरम्भेण प्रणय-कोपावेशेन विह्वला विवशा दष्टाधरोष्ठा कटाः कटाक्षाः, तैर् ये आक्षेपाः परिभवाः, तैस् ताडयन्तीवैक्षत् ॥६॥ — She frowned and twisted her eyebrows, overwhelmed with love and anger, and helplessly bit her lips, cut off her gaze, and beat them with the insults which she had overcome.
6.translation: She frowned and twisted her eyebrows, overwhelmed with love and anger, and helplessly bit her lips, cut off her gaze, and beat them with the insults which she had overcome.

7.word_for_word: अनिमिषन्तीभ्याम् अनिमीलन्तीभ्यां दृग्भ्याम् आपीतम् अपि सम्यग् दृष्टम् अपि पुनः पुनर् जुषाणा नातृप्यत् ॥७॥ — Though she had drunk it with her eyes which did not blink and had not closed it she was not satisfied even though she had seen it well again and again.
7.translation: Though she had drunk it with her eyes which did not blink and had not closed it she was not satisfied even though she had seen it well again and again.

8.word_for_word: हृदि-कृत्य हृदयं नीत्वेत्य् अर्थः ॥८॥ — Heart-making means taking the heart.

9.word_for_word: प्राज्ञम् ईश्वरं प्राप्य यथा मुमुक्षवो जनाः । — Just as people who seek liberation have attained a wise God; यद् वा, प्राज्ञं ब्रह्म-ज्ञानं प्राप्य यथा संसारिणः । — Or rather, as the worldly, having attained the knowledge of the wise, the Brahman.; यद् वा, प्राज्ञं सौषुप्तं प्राप्य यथा विश्व-तैजसावस्था जीवाः ॥९॥ — Or that, having attained the wise asleep, as the living entities are in the state of cosmic effulgence.; : सौषुप्तं सुषुप्ति-साक्षिणम् इत्य् अर्थः । — means to be asleep and to witness asleep.
9.translation: Just as people who seek liberation have attained a wise God Or rather, as the worldly, having attained the knowledge of the wise, the Brahman. Or that, having attained the wise asleep, as the living entities are in the state of cosmic effulgence. means to be asleep and to witness asleep.

10.word_for_word: पुरुषः परमात्मा शक्तिभिः सत्त्वादिभिर् यथा । — The Supreme Soul is the Supreme Soul, just as the powers of goodness and others are.; यद् वा, उपासकः पुरुषो ज्ञान-बल-वीर्यादिभिः । — That is, the worshiper is endowed with knowledge, strength, power and so on.; यद् वा, पुरुषोऽनुशायी प्रकृत्य्-आद्य्-उपाधिभिर् वृतो यथाऽधिकं विरोचते, तद्वत् ॥१०॥ — That is, the more the man, lying down, surrounded by the elements of nature and others, the more he shines.
10.translation: The Supreme Soul is the Supreme Soul, just as the powers of goodness and others are. That is, the worshiper is endowed with knowledge, strength, power and so on. That is, the more the man, lying down, surrounded by the elements of nature and others, the more he shines.

11-12.word_for_word: विकसत्-कुन्द-मन्दारैः सुरभिर् योऽनिलः, तस्मात् षट्पदा यस्मिंस् तत् ॥११॥ — The air which is fragrant with the blossoming kunda and mandara trees is the source of the bees in which they live.; शरच्-चन्द्रांशूनां सन्दोहैः समूहैर् ध्वस्तं दोषातमो रात्रि-गतं तमो यस्मिंस् तत् । — The darkness of the night is destroyed by the clusters of doubtful rays of the autumn moon.; अतः शिवं सुख-करम् । — Therefore, Shiva is the source of happiness.; हस्त-रूपैस् तरलैस् तरङ्गैर् आचिता आस्तृता कोमला बालुका यस्मिन् । — In which the soft sand is spread out and covered with liquid waves in the form of hands.; एवं-भूतं पुलिनं ताः समादाय निर्विश्य ताभिर् वृतोऽधिकं व्यरोचतेति पूर्वेणान्वयः॥१२॥ — Thus having taken them to the sandy beach, having entered it, surrounded by them, it shone even more, as the consequence of the former.
11-12.translation: The air which is fragrant with the blossoming kunda and mandara trees is the source of the bees in which they live. The darkness of the night is destroyed by the clusters of doubtful rays of the autumn moon. Therefore, Shiva is the source of happiness. In which the soft sand is spread out and covered with liquid waves in the form of hands. Thus having taken them to the sandy beach, having entered it, surrounded by them, it shone even more, as the consequence of the former.

13.word_for_word: ताश् च मनोरथानाम् अन्तं ययुः पूर्ण-कामा बभूवुः । — They came to the end of their desires and became fulfilled; श्रुतयो यथा इति । — as in the scriptures.; अयम् अर्थः---यथा कर्म-काण्डे श्रुतयः परमेश्वरम् अपश्यन्त्यस् तत्-तत्-कामानुबन्धैर् अपूर्णा इव भवन्ति, ज्ञान-काण्डे तु परमेश्वरं दृष्ट्वा तद्-आह्लाद-पूर्णाः कामानुबन्धं जहति, तद्वद् इति । — This means that just as in the karma-kanda the scriptures seem to be incomplete with the attachments of their desires when they do not see God, so in the jnana-kanda one who sees God and is full of that joy gives up the attachment of desires.; आप्त-कामा अपि प्रेम्णा तम् अभजन्न् इत्य् आह---स्वैर् इति । — Even those who had fulfilled their desires worshiped Him with love, he argues, by their own.; अचीकॢपन् रचयामासुः । — They created the Achikilpan.; आत्म-बन्धवेऽन्तर्यामिणे ॥१३॥ — To the self-relationship, the innermost.
13.translation: They came to the end of their desires and became fulfilled as in the scriptures. This means that just as in the karma-kanda the scriptures seem to be incomplete with the attachments of their desires when they do not see God, so in the jnana-kanda one who sees God and is full of that joy gives up the attachment of desires. Even those who had fulfilled their desires worshiped Him with love, he argues, by their own. They created the Achikilpan. To the self-relationship, the innermost.

14.word_for_word: गोपी-सभा-गतस् ताभिः संमानितः सन् चकास शुशुभे। — He shone as he went to the assembly of the gopis and was honored by them.; त्रैलोक्ये या लक्ष्मीः शोभा, तस्या एकम् एव पदं स्थानं तद् वपुर् दधद् दर्शयन् ॥१४॥ — The goddess of fortune who is the beauty in the three worlds has only one foothold and place, showing that body.
14.translation: He shone as he went to the assembly of the gopis and was honored by them. The goddess of fortune who is the beauty in the three worlds has only one foothold and place, showing that body.

15.word_for_word: स-हास-लीलेक्षणेन विभ्रमो विलासो यस्यां, तया भ्रुवा उपलक्षिताः । — Her eyebrows were marked by the luxury of confusion with her smile and playful eyes.; संस्पर्शनेन संमर्दनेन ॥१५॥ — by touching and rubbing.
15.translation: Her eyebrows were marked by the luxury of confusion with her smile and playful eyes. by touching and rubbing.

16.word_for_word: तत्र भगवतोऽकृतज्ञतां तद्-वचनेनैवापादयितु-कामा गूढाभिप्राया लोक-वृत्तान्तम् इव पृच्छन्ति---भजत इति । — There, desiring to prove their ingratitude to the Lord by His own words, they ask, as if they were the history of the world, asking, “Who worships?”; भजतः प्राणिनः । — The creatures who worship.; अनु अनन्तरं केचित् तद्-भजनानुसारेण भजन्ति । — After that, some worship according to the worship of the Lord.; केचिद् एतद् विपर्ययं यथा भवति तथा तद्-भजनान् अपेक्षम् अभजतोऽपि भजन्ति । — Some, as this is the opposite, worship those who worship Him regardless of what they do.; अन्ये तु नोभयान् इति ॥१६॥ — Others, however, say that neither.; : उभयान् भजतः अभजतश् च । — Both worship and non-worship.
16.translation: There, desiring to prove their ingratitude to the Lord by His own words, they ask, as if they were the history of the world, asking, “Who worships?” The creatures who worship. After that, some worship according to the worship of the Lord. Some, as this is the opposite, worship those who worship Him regardless of what they do. Others, however, say that neither. Both worship and non-worship.

17.word_for_word: विदिताभिप्राय उत्तरम् आह---मिथ इति । — The answer to the known intention is that it is a myth.; हे सख्यः ! — O friends!; उपकार-प्रत्युपकारतया ये मिथो भजन्ति तेऽन्यं न भजन्ति, किं त्व् आत्मानम् एव । — Those who worship one another in return for benefits do not worship anyone else, but themselves.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; हि यस्मात् । — for since.; स्वार्थ एव एकान्त उद्यमो येषां ते । — Those whose sole enterprise is selfishness; तत्र च न सौहृदम् अतो न सुखम्, न च धर्मो दृष्टोद्देशाद् गो-महिष्य्-आदि-भजनवद् इत्य् अर्थः ॥१७॥ — There is no friendship, therefore no happiness, nor righteousness, as in the worship of cows, buffaloes, etc., for the sake of sight, this means.; : स्वार्थे स्वीये दृष्ट-फले । — In selfishness, in one’s own seen-fruit.; : न सौहृदं कैतवमयत्वात् । — Not friendship, since it is made up of prisoners.
17.translation: The answer to the known intention is that it is a myth. O friends! Those who worship one another in return for benefits do not worship anyone else, but themselves. Where is it from? for since. Those whose sole enterprise is selfishness There is no friendship, therefore no happiness, nor righteousness, as in the worship of cows, buffaloes, etc., for the sake of sight, this means. In selfishness, in one’s own seen-fruit. Not friendship, since it is made up of prisoners.

18.word_for_word: ये त्व् अभजतो भजन्ति, ते द्विविधाः---करुणाः स्निग्धाश् च । — Those who worship those who do not worship are of two kinds: compassionate and affectionate.; तत्र तु यथा-क्रमं धर्म-कामौ भवत इत्य् आह---भजन्त्य् अभजत इति ॥१८॥ — But there, in the order in which religion and desire are fulfilled, he argues that they worship and they do not worship.
18.translation: Those who worship those who do not worship are of two kinds: compassionate and affectionate. But there, in the order in which religion and desire are fulfilled, he argues that they worship and they do not worship.

19.word_for_word: तृतीय-प्रश्नोत्तरं भजतोऽप्+ईति । — The answer to the third question is ap+e from the worshipper.; अयम् अर्थः---ते तु चतुर्-विधाः---एके आत्मारामा अपराग्-दृशः, केचिद् आप्त-कामा विषय-दर्शिनोऽपि पूर्ण-कामत्वेन भोगेच्छा-रहिताः, अन्ये अकृतज्ञा मूढाः, अन्ये तु गुरु-द्रुहोऽतिकठिनाः । — This means that they are of four kinds: some are self-satisfied and have a vision of the other, some are devoid of the desire for pleasure because they are full of desire, even though they see objects as fulfilled, others are ungrateful and foolish, and others are very difficult to hate their teachers.; "स पिता यस् तु पोषकः" इति न्यायाद् उपकर्ता गुरु-तुल्यस् तस्मै द्रुह्यन्तीति तथा ते ॥१९॥ — "He is the father who is the breadwinner," according to the law, and the helper is equal to the teacher, and so they are angry with him.
19.translation: The answer to the third question is ap+e from the worshipper. This means that they are of four kinds: some are self-satisfied and have a vision of the other, some are devoid of the desire for pleasure because they are full of desire, even though they see objects as fulfilled, others are ungrateful and foolish, and others are very difficult to hate their teachers. "He is the father who is the breadwinner," according to the law, and the helper is equal to the teacher, and so they are angry with him.

20.word_for_word: अत्र चरम-कोटि-गतम् आत्मानं मत्वा, अक्षि-संकोचैः परस्परं गूढ-स्मित-मुखीस् ता दृष्ट्वा आह---नाहं त्व् इति । — Here, thinking himself to be in the extreme crown, he looked at them with narrowed eyes and a mysterious smile on his face.; हे सख्यः ! — O friends!; अहं तेषां मध्ये न कोऽपि, किं तु परम-कारुणिकः परम-सुहृच् च । — I am none of them, but the most compassionate and the most friendly.; कथम् ? — How's it going?; अमीषां भजताम् अनुवृत्ति-वृत्तये निरन्तर-ध्यान-प्रवृत्त्य्-अर्थं तान् न भजामि । — I do not worship these devotees for the sake of following them and for the sake of constant meditation.; एतत् स-दृष्टान्तम् आह---यथा इति । — He argues for this co-example: as follows.; तस्य धनस्यैव चिन्तया निभृतः पूर्णः, व्याप्त इति यावत् । — That is, he is filled and pervaded by the thought of that wealth alone.; अन्यत् क्षुत्-पिपासाद्य् अपि न वेद ॥२०॥ — He does not know anything else, even hunger and thirst.
20.translation: Here, thinking himself to be in the extreme crown, he looked at them with narrowed eyes and a mysterious smile on his face. O friends! I am none of them, but the most compassionate and the most friendly. How's it going? I do not worship these devotees for the sake of following them and for the sake of constant meditation. He argues for this co-example: as follows. That is, he is filled and pervaded by the thought of that wealth alone. He does not know anything else, even hunger and thirst.

21.word_for_word:
एवं मद्-अर्थोज्झित-लोक-वेद-स्वानां मद्-अर्थे उज्झितो लोको युक्तायुक्ताप्रतीक्षणात्, वेदश् च धर्माधर्माप्रतीक्षणात्, स्वा ज्ञातयश् च स्नेह-त्यागात् याभिस् तासां वो युष्माकं परोक्षम् अदर्शनं यथा भवति, — Thus, the world, the Vedas, and their own, who have abandoned My purpose, have abandoned the world for My purpose by waiting for the righteous, the Vedas by waiting for righteousness, and the Vedas by waiting for righteousness and righteousness, and by the renunciation of affection for their relatives.; तथा भजता युष्मत्-प्रेमालापान् शृण्वतैव तिरोहितम् अन्तर्धानेन स्थितम् । — Thus, while I was worshiping You, I disappeared and stood in disappearance as soon as I heard the conversations of Your love.; तत् तस्मात् हे अबलाः ! — That is why, O weak ones!; हे प्रियाः, मा माम् असूयितुं दोषारोपेण द्रष्टुं यूयं मार्हथ न योग्याः स्थ ॥२१॥ — O dear ones, do not envy Me, for you deserve to be seen as guilty, for you are not worthy.; : यद् वा, मा-द्वयं निषेधे । — or, in the prohibition of ma-two.; तथापि प्रियं मल्-लक्षणम्
असूयितुं मार्हथेति मा । — Still, cute mall characteristics
Don’t think you deserve to be jealous.; अपि तु मया दत्त-दुःखत्वाद् अथैवेति । — Rather, it is because of the pain I have given.
21.translation:
Thus, the world, the Vedas, and their own, who have abandoned My purpose, have abandoned the world for My purpose by waiting for the righteous, the Vedas by waiting for righteousness, and the Vedas by waiting for righteousness and righteousness, and by the renunciation of affection for their relatives. Thus, while I was worshiping You, I disappeared and stood in disappearance as soon as I heard the conversations of Your love. That is why, O weak ones! O dear ones, do not envy Me, for you deserve to be seen as guilty, for you are not worthy. or, in the prohibition of ma-two. Still, cute mall characteristics
Don’t think you deserve to be jealous. Rather, it is because of the pain I have given.

22.word_for_word: आस्ताम् इदम्, परमर्थं तु शृणुतेत्य् आह---नेति । — Let this be, but listen to the ultimate meaning.; निरवद्या संयक् संयोगो यासां, तासां वो विबुधानाम् आयुषापि चिर-कालेऽपि स्वीयं साधु कृत्यं प्रत्युपकारं कर्तुं न पारये न शक्नोमि । — I cannot, nor can I, even in the long life of you, the demigods, who have been in perfect union with you, repay you for your good deeds.; कथं-भूतानाम् ? — How-of-the-beings?; या भवत्यो दुर्जरा अजरा या गेह-शृङ्खलाः, ताः संवृश्च्य निःशेषं छित्त्वा मा माम् अभजन्, तासाम् । — Do not worship Me by cutting off the chains of your household, which are infirm and immortal.; मच्-चित्तं तु बहुषु प्रेम-युक्ततयानैक-निष्ठम् । — My mind, however, is fixed on one because it is full of love for many.; तस्माद् वो युष्माकम् एव साधुना साधु-कृत्येन तत् युष्मत्-साधु-कृत्यं प्रतियातु, प्रतिकृतं भवतु । — Therefore, by your own good deeds, may that good deed of yours be repaid.; युष्मच्-छौशील्येनैव ममानृण्यम्, न तु मत्-कृत-प्रत्युपकारेणेत्य् अर्थः ॥२२॥ — This means that I am indebted to you for your good manners alone, not for the benefits you have rendered to me.; : यद् वा विगतो बुधो गणनाभिज्ञो यस्मात् तेनानन्तेनायुषापि । — Or whatever the wise man, who is not able to count, has passed away, even with his infinite life.
22.translation: Let this be, but listen to the ultimate meaning. I cannot, nor can I, even in the long life of you, the demigods, who have been in perfect union with you, repay you for your good deeds. How-of-the-beings? Do not worship Me by cutting off the chains of your household, which are infirm and immortal. My mind, however, is fixed on one because it is full of love for many. Therefore, by your own good deeds, may that good deed of yours be repaid. This means that I am indebted to you for your good manners alone, not for the benefits you have rendered to me. Or whatever the wise man, who is not able to count, has passed away, even with his infinite life.
